selection_rule: Use replicate 02 from the same three preregistered region-size strata as G5. No result from these instances was inspected for algorithm selection.
controls: The same three equal-CPU homogeneous ensembles used in G5.
gate: Across the three fresh cases, AMV-HGS-ALNS must have zero strict losses versus the best homogeneous control available on each case and at least one strict win. All solutions must be feasible and independently rescored.
no_rescue: Do not change the algorithm or constants after G5.
Do not replace cases, controls, or seeds.
Do not run G6 if G5 fails.
One seed group is directional confirmation, not formal statistical evidence.
